status: Source-only model-family gate; target future remains closed.
claim_boundary: This protocol may admit an exploratory five-case target-prefix gate. The five targets have been examined previously and cannot establish an independent SOTA claim.
hypothesis: A graph-local nonlinear model trained with recursive multi-step source losses can predict action-conditioned residual evolution that endpoint persistence and one-step linear regressions miss.

information_boundary.source_training: Complete registered source outcomes may supervise multi-step dynamics.
information_boundary.source_validation: Each source case is scored only by a model trained without that case.
information_boundary.target_access: No target trajectory, observation, metric, or future artifact is read by this gate.
information_boundary.prob4d: Prob4D is intentionally deferred until this dynamics family passes using trusted source residuals; a causal prefix-only Prob4D adapter is then evaluated as a separate observation arm.

forbidden: opening any target future when the source gate fails
changing folds, architecture, seeds, blend candidates, or thresholds after source results
calling a passing target-five result independent or state of the art
using all-frame Prob4D overlap archives as causal target-prefix observations
